description: This file defines the QueryParser class, which creates Query objects from search commands such as QueryThings, StreamThings, and SudoCountThings. It contains methods for parsing criteria and options from search commands and returning appropriate Query objects for execution within the application.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A utility class responsible for parsing search commands into Query objects that can be executed by the data layer. It handles various command types, applies options, and constructs criteria.

methods.name: of
methods.description: A static factory method for creating a QueryParser instance with specified criteria factory, field expression factory, and query builder factory.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Converts a ThingSearchQueryCommand into a Query object, considering options and criteria.

methods.name: parseSudoCountThings
methods.description: Converts a SudoCountThings command into a Query object for counting things, applying filters and headers.

methods.name: getCriteriaFactory
methods.description: Returns the CriteriaFactory used internally, derived from the queryFilterCriteriaFactory.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Creates Criteria from a given command, considering namespace restrictions.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Parses and applies options to a QueryBuilder, handling exceptions and invalid options.
